# SPUN (a Snow Patch U-Net)

This pages is a home for visualisations and dashboards generated using the [SPUN (Snow Patch U-Net)](https://github.com/leamhowe/spun) deep learning model for mapping snow cover from Sentinel-2 imagery. SPUN was designed for mapping snowpatches in the Scottish Highlands (as part of my PhD research studying these small decametre-scale features) but shows promise for wider applications in snow mapping and monitoring. 

**You can read more details about the SPUN model in our preprint:** [https://egusphere.copernicus.org/preprints/2026/egusphere-2026-3163/](https://egusphere.copernicus.org/preprints/2026/egusphere-2026-3163/) 


## Tracking snowpatches in the Scottish Highlands

SPUN was primarily intended as a tool for tracking late-lying snowpatches in the Scottish Highlands as part of my PhD research. Here we present the melt-season snowmaps derived using SPUN and zoomed in on iconic snowpatch locations:

- [The Sphinx snowpatch, Braeriach](assets/dashboards/Braeriach_late_snow_dashboard_occluded55_suspect30.html)
- [Ciste Mhearad (Margaret's Coffin) snowpatch, Cairn Gorm Mountain](assets/dashboards/Cairn_Gorm_late_snow_dashboard_occluded55_suspect30.html)
- Aonach Beag snowpatch, coming soon...
- Ben Nevis, coming soon...



## Cairngorms snow cover

The [Cairngorms National Park](https://www.visitcairngorms.com/cairngorms-national-park-map/) is the snowiest region in the UK — a unique subarctic-alpine landscape characterised by its high plateaus, rugged terrain and diverse ecosystems, making it an ideal location for studying snow dynamics in a mountainous environment. Here we present a dashboard of SPUN snow maps for the whole national park spanning 2016-2026:

- [Dashboard of SPUN snow cover maps for the Cairngorms, 2016-2026](assets/dashboards/CNP_snow_dashboard_QCflags_sunangle22_cloud80.html)
<!-- - [2017–18](dashboards/CNP_snow_dashboard_2018.html) -->


We have used these snowmaps to derive annual and Sentinel-2 wide snow persistence maps for the Cairngorms at 10 m resolution (higher than ever before):
